tagline: Road intelligence from drivers who choose to share.
description: Lanevia makes an affordable AI dash cam that detects work zones, closures and road hazards, and shares that road data only with each driver's consent.
announcement: Concept demo: Phase 1 pilot planned for Indianapolis.
disclaimer: Lanevia is a concept startup created for an Indiana University S307 class project (Group 10). Product, companies and data shown are fictional.
